newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse warns investors on rumours, politics.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse warns investors on rumours, politics.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand on Thursday warned investors to trade cautiously after the latest political developments and to ignore rumours that may arise about some listed companies as a result.
Thai finance minister Amnuay Viravan resigned on Thursday and his departure triggered a sell-off in the bourse, which is now at new eight-year lows.

"The Stock Exchange of Thailand is warning investors over recent political developments and speculation on a number of issues that may have been influencing the market and the economy as a whole," the SET said in a statement without giving any details.
"The SET urges investors to ignore any speculation or rumours concerning financial institutions or firms in the property and industrial sectors," it said.
The bourse said it would like to reassure investors that many listed companies still have sound fundamentals in terms of their operations and performance.
